definitions.explanation: The height above sea level or ground level, especially used for aircraft.
Describing something of an advanced or sophisticated level.

⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高度|こうど}１⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: The airplane is flying at an altitude of 10,000 meters.

examples.english: Solving this problem requires advanced knowledge and experience, and is difficult without an expert.

notes:
{高度|こうど} has two main uses:

1. As a noun meaning altitude/height (especially for aircraft or mountains)
2. As a na-adjective meaning advanced or high-level

Common collocations:
- {高度|こうど}を{上|あ}げる (to gain altitude)
- {高度|こうど}を{下|さ}げる (to lose altitude)
- {高度|こうど}な{技術|ぎじゅつ} (advanced technology)
- {高度|こうど}{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう} (high economic growth)
- {高度|こうど}{情報化|じょうほうか}{社会|しゃかい} (advanced information society)

Note: When used as a na-adjective, it implies sophistication or being high-level.
